query:
SELECT
                value as nullifier_value,
                loan_operation_type as operation_type,
                operation_amount,
                created_at as operation_timestamp,
                tree_index,
                batch_id,
                user_id,
                operation_metadata
            FROM nullifiers
            WHERE loan_operation_type = $1
                AND created_at >= $2
                AND created_at <= $3
                AND is_active = true
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT $4
